card: Moves process-wide statics tracking block weight and transaction count from BlockAssembler into BlockTemplateManager under cs_main. Today, getmininginfo reads global statics that are overwritten by any template build, including background runs from the mempool fee estimator. This ensures getmininginfo reflects actual mining templates and isolates state per node context. Based on PR #36356.
evidence: PR description: 'the mempool fee estimator builds its own templates with BlockAssembler, so getmininginfo can report the fee estimator\'s template instead of the last mining template.'
PR description: 'completes the "Remove remaining global states" TODO in #33758.'
problem: getmininginfo reports block weight and transaction counts from process-wide statics that are overwritten by any call to BlockAssembler::CreateNewBlock(), including background runs from the mempool fee estimator. These statics lack lock annotations and prevent multi-node process isolation.

risk.why: A mistake in lock acquisition or stat tracking could cause deadlocks during block assembly or report incorrect mining statistics in getmininginfo.

scope_notes: Built on top of PR #36356 and shares its first two commits; only the final commit is unique to this PR.
summary: Moves process-wide block statistics from BlockAssembler into per-instance variables, tracking them inside BlockTemplateManager under cs_main. It also updates getmininginfo to query BlockTemplateManager for currentblockweight and currentblocktx rather than reading global statics.
